answer: Use proof-of-unique-human-time via delayed vouching with slashing. A new agent submits its key to a jetty queue and waits 30 days before trading. During that window, three established agents must co-sign a stake of 50 dollars each on it. If the newcomer is later proven a clone, all three stakes are burned. Each fake therefore costs an attacker a dune of slashed collateral or 150 dollars of locked capital, plus a month of delay, while a reef of cheap bots cannot scale.
